== English Endor comparison ==
The 2022 Appendix A and 2023 Appendix A revise the lore. The printed original and the current publisher image both quote hologram games. The documentary revision keeps the original game text and the same printed attributes. The January 2002 supplement had already ruled on its Hologram status.
